BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential is delighted to present 28 Clogher Road to the Dublin 12 property market.

Nestled within a mature and highly sought-after residential area in Crumlin, this charming two-bedroom home offers bright, spacious, and well-proportioned accommodation extending to approximately 72 sq.m. Ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors, this property combines comfort, convenience, and excellent potential.

The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a cosy living room, and an extended open-plan kitchen/dining area, creating an ideal space for everyday family living and entertaining. Upstairs, there are two generously sized double bedrooms and a well-appointed family bathroom.

Externally, the property benefits from spacious front and rear gardens, offering excellent outdoor space with potential for further enhancement (subject to the necessary planning permission).

The location is second to none, with an abundance of amenities close by in Sundrive, Kimmage, Terenure, and Harold's Cross. Residents can enjoy a wide selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, well-established schools, parks, and sports facilities. The new National Children's Hospital is also within easy reach.

Excellent transport links include numerous bus routes providing quick access to Dublin City Centre, the M50, and surrounding areas, making this an exceptionally convenient place to call home.

Early viewing is highly recommended.

Some information may have been supplied by the vendor. Interested parties are advised to satisfy themselves as to the accuracy of all information through their own inspection and professional advice.*
